title: Cesar demands $10,000 to talk to RFK Jr.

tellings.quote: I've talked to Bobby about it and Bobby was going to go be meeting with the fellow to try to get him to do it and the guy insisted upon being paid you know $110,000

plain: Dan Sheehan, a guest on Jesse Michels's podcast, says he talked about a man called Cesar with Robert F. Kennedy Jr., the American politician from the Kennedy family. According to Sheehan, Kennedy was going to meet the man to get him to talk, but the man insisted on being paid a large sum first, which Sheehan puts at about $110,000.
